# QrSortable - Smart QR Code & Barcode Storage Labels

> QrSortable connects physical QR code and Code-128 barcode labels (available as pre-printed waterproof packs and instant printable A4/A5 PDF sheets) to digital inventory records containing item lists, high-resolution photos, remarks, locations, and categories—so households, movers, warehouses, and businesses know what is inside every box before opening it.
